old_dataset.survivor_cohort: All 1194 are FINAL_SURVIVOR (99.9%) - no non-survivor cohort to attribute

FINAL_SURVIVOR.note: Survivors contributed +139k, similar to old dataset's 166k but slightly lower due to universe competition

HISTORICAL_NON_SURVIVOR.note: Historical losers dragged return down by 8.9k, explaining part of the 19.7pp return delta

RENAMED_ENTITY.note: FB->META handled as one entity, no double-count, pnl included in survivor

LATE_ENTRY.note: Late entries after 2017 are in both datasets; their contribution is within survivor/nonsurvivor

turnover.note: Turnover similar, not the driver of return delta

universe_breadth.note: New dataset has slightly higher avg holdings (6.35 vs 5.55) due to more candidates, but exposure similar (0.599 vs 0.548)

new_dataset.attribution_summary: Return drop from 1.6648 to 1.4672 (-0.197) is explained by: (1) historical losers selected (-8.9k direct), (2) universe competition/ranking change (survivor pnl 139k vs old 166k), (3) not by turnover or exposure. Survivorship bias inflated old return by ~19.7pp, Sharpe by 0.052, maxDD slightly better in new (-0.008).
